module purpose: A small read-only boot ROM: on each clock it samples the initialized ROM image at an address taken from the bus request and, when a bus read is requested, drives the response bundle (data and ack); err is tied low.

use-case flows.value: read-request decision (a bus read is detected)
memory read: select a ROM word by bus_req_i.addr and capture it into rdata on clk_i
deliver the sampled ROM word on the response data port when rden is asserted
report read completion via ack (bus_rsp_o.ack driven from rden)
clear the response-enable state (rden) when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Boot ROM contents (the 32-bit words initialized into mem_rom_c) that the module returns on bus reads
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL implements a read-out flow in which the ROM image is indexed and sampled into a register and then presented on the response port: mem_access assigns rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(...)))) on the clock edge (line 48), and bus_rsp_o.data is driven from rdata when rden = '1' (line 64). The relationship map shows the address selecting which entry is read (bus_req_i.addr SELECTS rdata at the use on line 48), rdata is the registered storage of the sampled word (rdata CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 2 / line 48), and the response port field is derived from rdata (bus_rsp_o data DERIVES_FROM rdata at occurrence 2 / line 64). Therefore the correctness (integrity) of the ROM image as stored in mem_rom_c and as captured into rdata is established by the RTL for the read-out flow: changing the stored words or the stored rdata would change the value delivered on bus_rsp_o.data (lines 35, 48, 64; map records: SELECTS / CLOCKED_BY / DERIVES_FROM).

conceptual assets.concept: Read-response decision (rden) that determines when the ROM responds (drives ack and enables data)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL explicitly implements and uses a one-bit response-enable state: bus_feedback resets rden to '0' when rstn_i = '0' (line 58) and on the next rising_edge(clk_i) sets rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) (line 60). The response value then drives outputs: bus_rsp_o.ack <= rden (line 65) and bus_rsp_o.data is gated by (rden = '1') (line 64). The map shows bus_req_i.stb / bus_req_i.rw gate rden (GATES -> rden at occurrence on line 60), rden is a clocked register (rden CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3 / line 60), and bus_rsp_o.ack is copied from rden (bus_rsp_o.ack COPIES rden at bus_rsp_o occurrence 3 / line 65). Thus the integrity of the rden decision is established by the RTL for the reporting and data-gating flows: corrupting rden or the logic that sets it would make the module assert or withhold ack/data incorrectly (lines 55-61, 64-65; map records: GATES / CLOCKED_BY / COPIES).
